name: e2e-csharp-native-cleanup
title: E2E benchmark projects: finish the C#-native cleanup
description: Repair benchmarks/WinForward.E2E, WinForward.E2E.Contracts, WinForward.E2E.Analysis and their support scripts so they read as idiomatic C#/.NET projects of this repository rather than as a transliteration of the retired Python harness: remove the zero-value Python emulation (CPython RNG, %g/repr number and json.dumps text, glob and path spellings), normalise identifiers and conventions to the house style, and prune or relocate the scripts/ scaffolding that is dead, migration-only, or solution-scoped. Behavioural contract (record keys, table structure, disclosures) is preserved; the semantic oracle stays green.
creator: qmazon
